title_en: Near Zogu Te Black, at "Lion Residences 2", Super Apartment 1+1 Ideal for Investment!!
description_en: Near Zogu te Black, at "Lion Residences 2", Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, Ideal for investment!! The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services.
